model.name: vso:vsoModel
model.description: Operational Safety Oversight Model for Alfresco 25.2
model.author: VSO Team

property.name: vso:contentType
property.description: VSO business content classification

property.name: vso:inspectionType
property.description: Free-text label for the category of oversight activity. The canonical, machine-readable classification is the vso:activityTypeId/Code/Name triad on the vso:inspectionContext aspect; this property is a display/legacy label only and is not a lifecycle phase (lifecycle lives in vso:inspectionStatus).

property.name: vso:startDate
property.description: Inspection start date

property.name: vso:endDate
property.description: Inspection end date

property.name: vso:inspectionStatus
property.description: Current inspection lifecycle status

property.name: vso:checklistId
property.description: Unique identifier of the checklist (Lista de verificación), format LV-XXXXT####-EEE where XXXXT#### is the compact activity code (AV- prefix and dashes stripped) and EEE the specialty code. Example: LV-MDSDA0002-COM.

property.name: vso:scope
property.description: Checklist scope or inspection area

property.name: vso:completionDate
property.description: Date checklist was completed

property.name: vso:interviewee
property.description: Name of the person(s) interviewed during the checklist inspection

property.name: vso:itemId
property.description: Checklist item instance identifier

property.name: vso:itemCode
property.description: Reusable question code shared across checklists

property.name: vso:requirementText
property.description: Regulatory requirement being assessed

property.name: vso:itemVerificationMethod
property.description: Method used to verify compliance

property.name: vso:complianceStatus
property.description: Compliance assessment result

property.name: vso:inspectorComment
property.description: Inspector observations or remarks

property.name: vso:nominalRisk
property.description: Nominal risk level associated with the requirement

property.name: vso:hasOpenPriorFinding
property.description: Precomputed flag to speed up checklist searches for related prior findings that are not closed

property.name: vso:evidenceId
property.description: Unique evidence identifier

property.name: vso:evidenceType
property.description: Type of evidence (document, photo, log)

property.name: vso:source
property.description: Origin or system from which evidence was collected

property.name: vso:collectionDate
property.description: Date evidence was collected

property.name: vso:evidenceRole
property.description: Role of evidence in proving compliance or finding resolution

property.name: vso:collectionMethod
property.description: How this evidence entered the system: collected on-site by an inspector, or submitted remotely (by the inspector on the provider's behalf, or directly by the provider) and vetted before upload

property.name: vso:findingId
property.description: Finding identifier (Hallazgo), format H-XXXXT####-EEE-### where XXXXT#### is the compact activity code, EEE the specialty code and ### the finding's own 3-digit sequence. Example: H-MDSDA0002-COM-001.

property.name: vso:findingLevel
property.description: Finding classification

property.name: vso:findingSeverity
property.description: Severity level assigned by the inspector (A=7 days, B=30 days, C=90 days)

property.name: vso:riskClassification
property.description: Risk classification associated with the detected discrepancy

property.name: vso:targetResidualRisk
property.description: Target residual risk after corrective actions are implemented

property.name: vso:achievedResidualRisk
property.description: Residual risk actually achieved at time of closure approval

property.name: vso:requirementBreached
property.description: Regulatory reference breached

property.name: vso:checklistItemCode
property.description: Question code associated with this finding

property.name: vso:description
property.description: Detailed finding description

property.name: vso:findingStatus
property.description: Finding lifecycle status

property.name: vso:submissionDeadline
property.description: Deadline by which the regulated entity must submit a corrective action plan

property.name: vso:findingClosureDate
property.description: Date on which the finding was formally closed by the oversight authority. Written only by the closure review, when a reviewer approves, so it is null unless vso:findingStatus is Closed: a declaration (Pending Closure Approval) and a rejection (In Progress) both clear it, and no import may set it

property.name: vso:closureRequestedBy
property.description: User who declared the closure (the follow-up's enteredBy). The closure review must not be performed by this user: the two-step gate separates declaring effectiveness from verifying it

property.name: vso:closureRejectionReason
property.description: Why the closure review was rejected and the finding returned to In Progress. Null unless the reviewer rejected, and cleared when a new closure is declared

property.name: vso:dateIssued
property.description: Date the finding was formally raised, set on creation from the checklist upload

property.name: vso:lastStatusChange
property.description: Date the findingStatus was last updated, maintained by the Node backend on each transition

property.name: vso:resolutionDeadline
property.description: Deadline by which the finding must be resolved

property.name: vso:deadlineExtensionStatus
property.description: Status of the most recent resolution-deadline extension request, if any. A new request can only be submitted while this is unset or in a terminal state (Accepted/Rejected)

property.name: vso:requestedResolutionDeadline
property.description: The resolution deadline requested in the pending extension request; copied onto vso:resolutionDeadline only if the request is accepted

property.name: vso:deadlineExtensionReason
property.description: Reason given for the requested resolution-deadline extension

property.name: vso:deadlineExtensionRequestedDate
property.description: Date the resolution-deadline extension was requested

property.name: vso:deadlineExtensionDecisionDate
property.description: Date the resolution-deadline extension request was accepted or rejected

property.name: vso:findingReviewStatus
property.description: Whether a reviewer has confirmed this finding (separately from whoever formulated it in the field). Set to Pending Review on creation via the canonical import path

property.name: vso:findingReviewDate
property.description: Date the finding review was confirmed

property.name: vso:findingReviewedBy
property.description: Username of the reviewer who confirmed this finding

property.name: vso:capId
property.description: Corrective Action Plan identifier (Plan de acciones correctivas), format P-XXXXT####-EEE###-## where EEE### is the specialty code plus the parent finding's 3-digit sequence and ## is the CAP's own 2-digit sequence. Example: P-MDSDA0002-COM001-01.

property.name: vso:proposedAction
property.description: Description of corrective action

property.name: vso:responsibleEntity
property.description: Entity responsible for implementation

property.name: vso:dueDate
property.description: Corrective action due date

property.name: vso:acceptanceStatus
property.description: Acceptance status by authority

property.name: vso:capReviewedBy
property.description: Username of the reviewer who applied the acceptance decision

property.name: vso:capReviewDate
property.description: Date the acceptance decision was applied

property.name: vso:capReviewReason
property.description: Reviewer's justification for the acceptance decision — mandatory when the decision is Not Accepted

type.name: vso:capEvaluation
type.description: One manual review pass of a Corrective Action Plan against the IDAC-PAC-EVAL-01 checklist. A CAP accumulates one of these per review cycle (including after a reject/resubmit), preserving the full evaluation history.

property.name: vso:evaluatedBy
property.description: Username of the reviewer performing this evaluation pass

property.name: vso:evaluationDate
property.description: Date this evaluation pass was last updated

property.name: vso:evaluationDecisionOutcome
property.description: Acceptance decision this evaluation pass resulted in — set only once the reviewer confirms Accept/Reject; empty while the evaluation is still in progress

property.name: vso:evaluationDecisionReason
property.description: Reviewer's justification, set only when the outcome is Not Accepted

type.name: vso:capEvaluationCriterion
type.description: A single Sí/No/No aplica criterion (or free-text section conclusion) answered as part of a vso:capEvaluation pass, per the IDAC-PAC-EVAL-01 checklist.

property.name: vso:criterionCode
property.description: Catalog code, e.g. RCA.ROOT_CAUSE_CLEAR

property.name: vso:criterionSection
property.description: Catalog section this criterion belongs to, e.g. RCA, RISK, ADMIN

property.name: vso:criterionLabel
property.description: Label snapshot at evaluation time, so historical evaluations stay self-contained if catalog wording changes later

property.name: vso:criterionResponse
property.description: Sí/No/No aplica response — empty for conclusion-kind rows

property.name: vso:criterionObservations
property.description: Observation text for a Sí/No row, or the full text for a conclusion-kind row

property.name: vso:rcaMethod
property.description: Root cause analysis method used (5 Whys, Fishbone, BowTie, TapRooT, Barrier Analysis, Other)

property.name: vso:rcaOtherMethodDescription
property.description: Free-text description of the method used when rcaMethod is 'Other'

property.name: vso:rcaMainCategory
property.description: Main category responsible for the cause

property.name: vso:rootCause
property.description: Identified root cause

property.name: vso:contributingFactors
property.description: Contributing factors to the finding

property.name: vso:identifiedHazard
property.description: Identified hazard

property.name: vso:potentialConsequence
property.description: Potential consequence of the hazard

property.name: vso:raProbability
property.description: Probability, as defined by the inspected entity's own risk assessment methodology

property.name: vso:raSeverity
property.description: Severity, as defined by the inspected entity's own risk assessment methodology

property.name: vso:calculatedRiskLevel
property.description: Risk level calculated from probability and severity, per the entity's own methodology

property.name: vso:tolerabilityLevel
property.description: Tolerability level assigned to the calculated risk

property.name: vso:raJustification
property.description: Justification/explanation for the risk assessment outcome

property.name: vso:containmentDescription
property.description: Immediate containment measure(s) taken to reduce risk while the corrective action plan is implemented

property.name: vso:containmentImplementedDate
property.description: Date the containment measure was implemented

property.name: vso:sequenceNumber
property.description: Sequential number of this corrective action within the CAP

property.name: vso:actionDescription
property.description: Description of this corrective action

property.name: vso:actionPriority
property.description: Priority of this corrective action

property.name: vso:actionResponsiblePerson
property.description: Person responsible for executing this corrective action

property.name: vso:actionDeadline
property.description: Deadline for this corrective action

property.name: vso:actionItemStatus
property.description: Lifecycle status of this individual corrective action

property.name: vso:actionClosureDate
property.description: Date this corrective action was closed

property.name: vso:actionClosureNotes
property.description: Notes recorded when closing this corrective action

property.name: vso:residualProbability
property.description: Expected residual probability, as defined by the inspected entity's own methodology

property.name: vso:residualSeverity
property.description: Expected residual severity, as defined by the inspected entity's own methodology

property.name: vso:residualRiskLevel
property.description: Expected residual risk level after corrective actions are implemented

property.name: vso:residualJustification
property.description: Justification/explanation for the expected residual risk

property.name: vso:verificationMethod
property.description: Method by which the inspected entity will verify effectiveness of the corrective action plan

property.name: vso:verificationIndicators
property.description: Indicator(s) used to verify effectiveness

property.name: vso:projectedVerificationDate
property.description: Projected date of effectiveness verification

property.name: vso:followUpId
property.description: Follow-up report identifier (Seguimiento), auto-generated as S-XXXXT####-EEE###-## when omitted, sequenced per finding. EEE### is the specialty code plus the parent finding's 3-digit sequence; ## is the follow-up's own 2-digit sequence. Example: S-MDSDA0002-COM001-01.

property.name: vso:followUpType
property.description: Type of follow-up activity

property.name: vso:followUpDate
property.description: Date (and time) the follow-up was conducted in the field, as recorded by the checklist app

property.name: vso:percentComplete
property.description: Percentage of corrective action completion

property.name: vso:currentResidualRisk
property.description: Current residual risk at time of this follow-up, based on evidence provided

property.name: vso:followUpClosureDate
property.description: Date corrective action was closed

property.name: vso:closureVerificationMethod
property.description: Method used to verify effectiveness

property.name: vso:effectivenessConfirmed
property.description: Effectiveness verification result

property.name: vso:followUpComment
property.description: Free-text comment recorded during the follow-up

property.name: vso:evidenceReviewStatus
property.description: Whether a reviewer has judged this follow-up's evidence adequate. A follow-up cannot affect vso:findingStatus until this is Adequate

property.name: vso:evidenceReviewNotes
property.description: Reviewer's notes, particularly the reason when evidence is judged inadequate

property.name: vso:evidenceReviewDate
property.description: Date the evidence adequacy review decision was made

property.name: vso:evidenceReviewedBy
property.description: Username of the reviewer who applied the evidence adequacy decision

property.name: vso:inspectionId
property.description: Associated surveillance activity identifier (Actividad de vigilancia), format AV-XXXX-T-#### where XXXX is the 4-char ICAO location code, T the activity type letter and #### an independent 4-digit sequence per location and activity type. Example: AV-MDSD-A-0002. Sequenced independently of the parent site-visit code (V-XXXX-YYYY-##).

property.name: vso:activityTypeId
property.description: Canonical activity type identifier (ActivityType reference record in the AtroCore backend)

property.name: vso:activityTypeCode
property.description: Single-letter activity type code used in activity IDs, search and integrations: A=Auditoría, I=Inspección, M=Monitoreo, D=Revisión documental, S=Análisis de suceso. Deliberately unconstrained at model level because the ActivityType catalog is owned by the AtroCore backend and resolved dynamically.

property.name: vso:activityTypeName
property.description: Display name snapshot for the activity type

property.name: vso:locationId
property.description: Inspection location identifier

property.name: vso:locationCode
property.description: Stable location business code (for example ICAO code)

property.name: vso:locationName
property.description: Inspection location name

property.name: vso:specialtyId
property.description: Canonical specialty identifier

property.name: vso:specialtyCode
property.description: Human-friendly specialty code used in search and integrations

property.name: vso:specialtyName
property.description: Display name snapshot for specialty

property.name: vso:providerId
property.description: Service provider identifier under oversight

property.name: vso:providerName
property.description: Service provider name under oversight

property.name: vso:icaoReference
property.description: ICAO SARPs reference

property.name: vso:nationalRegulation
property.description: National regulation title

property.name: vso:regulationItem
property.description: Specific item/article in the national regulation

property.name: vso:ceMapping
property.description: USOAP Critical Element mapping

property.name: vso:areaMapping
property.description: Full set of USOAP area codes this node is relevant to (an artifact can support PQs from more than one area/CE via a single citation); vso:usoapAreaCode holds only the primary/first one

property.name: vso:scopeProviderId
property.description: Provider scope used by smart-folder templates

property.name: vso:scopeLocationCode
property.description: Location scope used by smart-folder templates

property.name: vso:scopeSpecialtyCode
property.description: Specialty scope used by smart-folder templates

property.name: vso:scopeProfileType
property.description: Profile selector for reusable templates

property.name: vso:usoapCriticalElement
property.description: USOAP critical element classification for any document

property.name: vso:usoapAreaCode
property.description: USOAP PQ area code (ATS, CNS, SAR, AIM, SMS, MET, AGA, P/OPS, CHT)

property.name: vso:usoapPqReference
property.description: Specific USOAP PQ identifier (e.g., PQ 7.035)

property.name: vso:usoapEvidenceBasis
property.description: Nature of the evidence supporting a PQ

property.name: vso:usoapTagSource
property.description: Whether the CE/area/PQ tags were resolved via the Annex-to-checklist-item citation chain or assigned directly on this node

property.name: vso:hashValue
property.description: Cryptographic hash of evidence

property.name: vso:immutable
property.description: Indicates if evidence is sealed

property.name: vso:sealedDate
property.description: Date evidence was sealed

property.name: vso:enteredBy
property.description: Alfresco user name of the inspector who entered the record. Verified server-side by compliance_import against the Alfresco authentication API; distinct from cm:creator, which is the service identity performing the import write.

property.name: vso:enteredByDisplayName
property.description: Display-name snapshot for vso:enteredBy

property.name: vso:enteredAt
property.description: Server-side UTC timestamp recorded when compliance_import accepted the payload

property.name: vso:inspectorId
property.description: AtroCore Inspector record identifier of the operator who entered the record

property.name: vso:enteredVia
property.description: How attribution was established: operator-login (verified Alfresco ticket) or service (no operator ticket)

property.name: vso:declaredBy
property.description: Operator selected in the checklist app at data-entry time, before server-side verification; retained for mismatch auditing
